College Name: IIT Madras (IITM) - Indian Institute of Technology Madras
Course Title: M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Madras (IITM) Offline Course
Course Description: Master of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering is two years (4 Semester) full-time postgraduate engineering program offered by Indian Institute of Technology Madras.
Eligibility Criteria: FOR GATE QUALIFIED CANDIDATES Candidates qualified in GATE 2022, GATE 2023, or GATE 2024 and satisfying any one of the following: i. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/ Technology/ Architecture from Educational Institutions approved by AICTE/ Government* ii. Master’s degree in Chemistry/ Life Sciences/ Mathematics/ Physics related subjects from educational Institutions approved by UGC/ Government* iii. Degrees obtained through Distance Education/ Correspondence Mode for the qualifying degree specified in [(i) or (ii)]. The Departments will follow suitability test/ interview procedure for screening in such cases. iv. Candidates yet to appear or have appeared in the final examination for the qualifying degree specified in [(i) or (ii)] and whose results are likely to be declared by July 15, 2024 v. Associate Membership holders of professional bodies for Admission into their parent disciplines from the following: • The Institution of Engineers (India) (AMIE) • The Aeronautical Society of India (AMAeSI) (eligible only for aerodynamics, structures, and propulsions streams) • The Indian Institute of Metals (AMIIM) • The Indian Institute of Chemical Engineers, including Polymer and Environmental Group (AMIIChemE) • The Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (AMIETE) * If the degree is issued by a university in countries other than India, the degree must be recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU)/ Commonwealth Universities/ International Association of Universities (IAU) as equivalent to the corresponding Indian Degrees/ Certificates. Additional requirements of GRE/ TOEFL may be required.FOR IIT GRADUATES Candidates graduating/ graduated from IITs with B.Tech. degree and having CGPA of 8.0 (on a scale of 10) and above can apply without GATE Score. These applications will be reviewed by the respective Department(s). FOR SPONSORED CANDIDATES Candidates employed and sponsored (with full pay and allowances for 24 months) by industry/ government organizations/ private and public enterprises, engaged in R&D work recognized by DST/ engineering colleges recognized by AICTE, possessing at least two years of professional experience as on the last date of receipt of applications at IIT Madras can apply, provided they hold: (i) B.E/ B.Tech. degree from AICTE recognized Engineering Colleges/ University with first class or 60% aggregate marks in all the four years (no need for having GATE Score); or (ii) AMIE or any other Associate memberships listed above (no need for having a GATE Score)
Selection Process: The admission for this programme is based on the percentile score in the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) and personal interviews conducted at IIT Madras.

Course Description: The M.S by Research programme is designed to be substantially different from the M.Tech. programme in its admission process, its emphasis on research over courses, and its relative flexibility of programme duration. A student must carry out research and submit a thesis as a graduation requirement. The maximum duration for fulfilling requirements of this program is 3 years, but the program is designed to incentivize high quality R&D by allowing students whose R&D work is exceptional to graduate early, in as little as 1.5 years.
Eligibility Criteria: Candidates with First class or 60% (55% marks for SC/ST) marks in (i). B.E./B.Tech./AMIE or equivalent in any engineering discipline. OR (ii). M.Sc. or equivalent in any science discipline. OR (iii). MCA (with undergraduate B.Sc. degree in Physics & Mathematics or BCA) or equivalent Valid GATE score (CS) is required for all applicants except those having B.Tech. Degree in CS/CSE from IITs with CGPA/CPI of 8.00 (on 0-10 scale) or above Admissions into the M.S. programme will be in TA/TAP and RAP categories. The TA/TAP and RAP stipends will be the same as for M. Tech. For both the categories, stipends will be given for a maximum of 36 months or until thesis submission, whichever is earlier
Selection Process: First, you apply for the MS programme using the same form as for MTech, but select the box where you are asked if you wish to apply for the MS programme in CSE.The admission process is identical for the TA and RAP positions for the MS by Research Program. The list of project  funded  RAP positions will be put up on the CSE website closer to the date of interviews.   Based on GATE scores, we will shortlist some number of candidates for a written test and an interview

The course in Masters in Biotechnology started at this Institute in 1986 was the first in the country based in a medical centre. to be conducted in Delhi/ NCR.

Course Title: M.Tech Computer Science at Department of Computer Science, University of Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram Offline Course
Course Description: Master of Technology (M.Tech) in Computer Science is a two-year full-time postgraduate program recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and offered by the University of Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram.
Eligibility Criteria: A Bachelor is degree in Engineering / Technology with at least 55% marks in one of the following branches: Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology / Electronics Engineering / Electrical Engineering from the University of Kerala or an equivalent recognized degree from a recognized University or First Class Master's degree in Computer Science / Computer Application from the University of Kerala or equivalent recognized degree of a recognized University. Admissions for the Non-sponsored category of students will be made on the basis of a valid GATE score. Candidates for sponsored seats will also be governed by the AICTE guidelines: (i) Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering / Technology (in branches mentioned above) with at least 55% marks from AICTE-approved institutions. Preference will be given to candidates who have qualified GATE. (ii) A minimum of two years of full-time work experience in a registered firm/company/industry / educational and research institution / any Government Department or Government Autonomous Organization in the relevant field. (iii) Less than 45 years of age as of 1st day of the year of admission.
Selection Process: Admissions for the Open category of students will be made on the basis of a valid GATE score. When GATE-qualified candidates are not available, admission will be given to Non-GATE candidates on merit. Such admissions will be based on an entrance test conducted by the Department.

College Name: IISER Pune - Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune
Course Title: Ph.D Earth and Climate Science at IISER Pune Offline Course
Course Description: The Ph.D. programme at IISER Pune is a blend of classroom curriculum, mentoring undergraduate students along with a major research component. The research scholars are expected to complete at least 16 credits of course work within the first two semesters followed by a comprehensive examination to assess the student’s candidacy for Ph.D. They must deliver a departmental seminar and undertake tutoring activities in at least two undergraduate courses (theory and/or laboratory courses). In the first two years, the student will receive a Junior Research Fellowship (JRF). Upon the successful completion of the comprehensive examination and two years of JRF, the student will be eligible to receive a Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) for a maximum of another three years. The research progress of the student will be monitored by a Research Advisory Committee (RAC) involving the thesis supervisor (Convener) and two other faculty members. Upon completion of satisfactory research work (as construed by the RAC), the research scholar will deliver a research seminar regarding his/her work before the submission of the thesis. The submitted thesis will be evaluated by external examiners before the conduct of viva-voce. Successful open defense of the thesis will lead to the award of Ph.D. degree during the annual convocation.
Eligibility Criteria: Students with minimum 60% marks in aggregate (overall percentage; not only in majoring subject) or a CGPA 6 out of 10 point scale (55% in aggregate or equivalent CGPA for SC/ST and PD candidates) in Master’s (or BS-MS) degree in Geology/ Applied Geology/Physics/Mathematics/Atmospheric Science/Climate Science/Engineering/Biology/Environmental Science, or related subjects. BE/BTech students may also apply.If a candidate has successfully completed a 4-year bachelor's degree (e.g., BS, B.Tech), it is appropriate to indicate "Not Applicable" in the Masters field, denoting that the candidate has not pursued a master's degree.
Selection Process: Candidate must have qualified in any ONE of the following     exams:National Eligibility Test (NET) with valid* CSIR-JRF / UGC-JRF/ UGC-LS/ CSIR-LS/ or a valid* GATE/JEST score,INSPIRE-PhD fellowship (The candidate should be in possession of provisional selection letter at the time of interview),*The score/rank MUST be valid at least till Aug 01, 2024.OR,BS-MS/Masters students from any of the Institutes of National Importance with a CGPA 8 or above on a 10-point scale are exempted from national-level test eligibility related criteria. Selection will be based on interviews of the short-listed candidates.

Course Description: The two-year Master of Science (MSc) programme at IISER Pune is a new programme, launched in the Academic year 2022-2023. It is aimed at highly motivated students with a bachelor's degree in any branch of science, who are interested in an intense in-depth enquiry in specialized areas of research and education, as available in different Departments in IISER Pune.
Eligibility Criteria: Students with a minimum of 60% marks overall percentage (not only in majoring subject) OR an equivalent C.G.P.A on a 10-point scale (For SC, ST, and PwD candidates, 55% overall percentage or an equivalent C.G.P.A on a 10-point scale) in BSc or an equivalent degree with Chemistry as one of the main subjects.ANDQualified JAM 2024 (Chemistry). The rank must be valid at the time of admission. Candidates will be shortlisted based on JAM rank.Candidates in the final year of their Bachelor’s degree are also eligible to apply. However, their final selection is subject to their successful completion of the Bachelor’s degree with the above-mentioned requirements at the time of admission.
Selection Process: Qualified JAM 2024 (Chemistry). The rank must be valid at the time of admission. Candidates will be shortlisted based on JAM rank.

College Name: IISER Pune - Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune
Course Title: Ph.D Mathematics at IISER Pune Offline Course
Course Description: The Ph.D. programme at IISER Pune is a blend of class room curriculum, mentoring under-graduate students along with a major research component. The research scholars are expected to complete at least 16 credits of course work within the first two semesters followed by a comprehensive examination to assess the student’s candidacy for Ph.D. They must deliver a departmental seminar and undertake tutoring activities in at least two under-graduate courses (theory and/or laboratory courses). In the first two years, the student will receive a Junior Research Fellowship (JRF). Upon the successful completion of the comprehensive examination and two years of JRF, the student will be eligible to receive a Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) for a maximum of another three years. The research progress of the student will be monitored by a Research Advisory Committee (RAC) involving the thesis supervisor (Convener) and two other faculty members. Upon completion of satisfactory research work (as construed by the RAC), the research scholar will deliver a research seminar regarding his/her work before the submission of the thesis. The submitted thesis will be evaluated by external examiners before the conduct of viva-voce. Successful open defense of the thesis will lead to the award of Ph.D. degree during the annual convocation.
Eligibility Criteria: Students with minimum 60% marks in aggregate (overall percentage; not only in majoring subject) or an equivalent C.G.P.A on a 10-point scale (55% or an equivalent C.G.P.A in aggregate for SC, ST and PD candidates) in any Master’s degree or B.E., B. Tech. in related branches satisfying the above criteria of marks can apply. If a candidate has successfully completed a 4-year bachelor's degree (e.g., BS, B.Tech), it is appropriate to indicate "Not Applicable" in the Masters field, denoting that the candidate has not pursued a master's degree.
Selection Process: Candidate MUST satisfy any ONE of the following criteria:Appeared for NBHM Ph.D. written exam in 2024 and was shortlisted in NBHM Doctoral Interview Shortlist (DIS). Qualified National Eligibility Test (NET) with valid* CSIR-JRF/UGC-JRF in Mathematics or Computer Science and Applications.Valid* GATE rank (Rank up to 60 for unreserved category candidates, and up to 75 for reserved category candidates) in Mathematics or Computer Science and Information Technology.BS-MS/Masters students from any of the Institutes of National Importance with a CGPA 8 or above on a 10-point scale are exempted from national-level test eligibility related criteria.(*Validity: The scores/ranks MUST be valid at the time of admission.)  For all the national eligibility examinations which provide a common rank/score, the cut-off rank/score for shortlisting for the Interviews for the reserved categories shall be lowered to 1.25 times the General category rank/score.Shortlisted applicants will have to clear a two-stage written examination to be held on the IISER Pune campus. Students clearing the written examinations will be called for an online interview. Candidates who clear the NBHM DIS interviews (Feb-March 2024) and hold a valid NBHM scholarship do not have to take the written examination and would be directly invited for the online interview.

College Name: NIT Calicut - National Institute of Technology Calicut
Course Title: MCA at NIT Calicut Offline Course
Course Description: The Master of Computer Applications (MCA) programme is offered by the Computer Science and Engineering Department of NITC. This is a three-year programme with one full semester devoted to project work. In addition to the core courses in Computer Science covering the basic knowledge areas, there are courses from Mathematics, Management and Humanities, which enable the students to acquire the required skills for a successful career. The elective courses offered in the emerging areas give them an opportunity to be in the forefront of technology and applications. Ample stress is given on software principles and practices to help them excel in their profession. The single-semester individual project is expected to give the student an experience to tackle a problem from its specification through design, implementation and testing, to possible deployment and maintenance planning.
Eligibility Criteria: Indian Nationals securing minimum 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5/10) for GEN/GEN-EWS/OBC and 55% marks (or CGPA 6.0/10) for SC/ST/PwD in (i) B.Sc./ B.Sc. (Hons)/ BCA/ BIT/ B.Voc.(Computer Science/ Computer Applications/ Software Development) of minimum three years full-time from a recognized University with Mathematics/Statistics as one of the subjects Or (ii) B.E./ B.Tech. from a recognized University are eligible to appear for NIMCET. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by individual Institute/university will not be considered / allowed. (CGPA other than 10-point scale will be converted to 10-point scale based on Unitary method)
Selection Process: N/A
